summary.headline: Astrological Questions 315–338
summary.text: Astrological question catalogue entries 315–338 cover war, possessions, inheritances, death, falling from power, inception, letters, marriage separation, requests, royal authority, dreams, travel, moving house, success, emancipation, selling, teaching, partnership, borrowing, fame, markets, and the truth of statements. The entries cite Dorotheus, Saturn, the Sun, Mercury, the Moon, Mars, lots, benefic and malefic stars, and horoscope placements, with cross-references to codex 6.
